name: netpulse
description: Local ethernet/broadband health and speed diagnostic system, with a companion mobile app

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix mobile && npm install && npm run build:mobile
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c "yellow,cyan" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix mobile
